def: The text, including instructions, examples and input, that a model is given to complete; in practice a program written in natural language.
Including a handful of worked input-output examples in the prompt so the model picks up the task, format and tone without any change to its weights.
Asking a model to do a task with instructions alone and no worked examples.
A marker such as an XML-style tag or a code fence that separates instructions from the data they operate on.
A reviewed prompt text with named placeholders that are filled, with escaping, by the data of each request.
Keeping prompts in version control with an identifier logged on every request, so any output can be traced to the exact prompt that produced it.
A table of inputs, expected results and checks used to compare prompt versions and catch regressions after a prompt or model change.
Running the same test cases through two versions and comparing them case by case, which detects small differences far better than comparing two totals.
The loss of weight of early rules against recent context in a long run, so the model gradually stops following them.
Standing instructions for an agent loop that state its process, its limits, what to do on repeated failure and the style of its replies.
